decisions.area: Medicine units, fractional stock and precision

recommendation.quantityRule: All four approved canonical stock units are counted as whole units; fractional quantity is rejected.
recommendation.conversion: Any outer packaging (for example strip, box or carton) must have an explicit per-medicine conversion factor to the approved canonical unit, proven from the package label/source. No automatic or assumed conversion.
recommendation.migration: Legacy quantities in unsupported units are preserved and quarantined for an explicit conversion map; no silent relabeling.

ownerMustConfirm: Source-verified conversion factors for any medicine currently recorded as strip/box/carton or another unit
blocks: Automatic conversion of legacy unsupported units until the medicine-specific factor is evidenced
evidence: Approved unit list and whole-unit rule from owner
Per-medicine package conversion evidence where required

recommendation.submission: Cashier submits a patient-return request tied to the original invoice line and original batch allocation.
approvals: Pimpinan approval is mandatory before any return quantity is restored to inventory
recommendation.afterApproval: After both approvals, returned quantity is recorded in a separate quarantined balance; it is not available to FEFO checkout.
recommendation.release: Admin is the designated role to perform/record the physical inspection and quarantine release, but only after Pimpinan approval is recorded. The medicine remains quarantined until Admin records a passing inspection and release event.
recommendation.rejection: Rejected, opened, damaged, expired or untraceable medicine remains non-sellable and is recorded with its disposition reason.
recommendation.accounting: Refund decision and inventory disposition are separate; approving a refund does not automatically make medicine sellable.

blocks: Sellable stock release until Pimpinan approval and Admin inspection/release event are both recorded
evidence: Admin inspection and quarantine release record with original invoice/batch link

recommendation.discountScope: Discount is applied separately to each service item/line; do not apply a package-wide discount allocation across multiple service components.
recommendation.snapshot: At checkout, persist each service line's gross price, discount amount and net charge in integer Rupiah.
recommendation.returnBasis: A returned/cancelled service line reverses only that line's original stored net charge and discount; do not recalculate using current prices.
recommendation.constraint: Invoice totals equal the sum of service-line net charges; all calculations use integer Rupiah.

evidence: Representative package receipts and partial-return examples

recommendation.workflow: All clinic expenses are entered/processed by Admin and require Pimpinan approval before posting as an approved expense.
recommendation.selfApproval: Admin cannot approve their own expense; Pimpinan is the approver.
recommendation.audit: Record requester, Admin recorder, Pimpinan approver, decision time, amount, category, evidence and reversal link.

recommendation.workflow: Remove cash advances, cash-bon and advance-settlement workflows from the application.
recommendation.expenseControl: All expenses are processed by Admin and are known to/approved by Pimpinan under D08.
recommendation.reporting: Only evidenced expense transactions are recorded; no outstanding employee-advance balance is created.

evidence: Current petty-cash categories and sample records

recommendation.stock: Supplier-return request has no stock effect; approved dispatch posts one negative movement against the original batch.
recommendation.paidInvoice: If the supplier invoice was already paid, record the returned value as a receivable/credit from the supplier.
recommendation.pending: Keep the supplier receivable Pending for as long as it remains unsettled; close it only when refund or offset is actually evidenced.
recommendation.oversight: Supplier return, receivable and settlement status must be visible to and known by Pimpinan; retain audit history.

ownerMustConfirm: Accepted evidence for supplier refund or offset settlement
blocks: Settlement evidence rules before closing supplier receivable
evidence: Sample paid and unpaid supplier return cases

recommendation.targetModel: Allow multiple payment events and partial allocations through a payment-to-payable allocation ledger.
recommendation.invariants: Each payment records date, amount and evidence. An allocation cannot exceed payment amount or remaining payable balance.
recommendation.paidStatus: An invoice is Lunas only when the entire obligation has been paid; otherwise the outstanding balance remains visible.
recommendation.legacy: A legacy lunas/paid boolean is status evidence only; never synthesize missing payment events or dates.

recommendation.default: The cashier who closes a shift cannot verify their own close.
recommendation.workflow: Preserve opening float, expected cash, counted cash, variance reason, verifier identity and timestamp as separate fields/events.
recommendation.authority: Kasir 1 and Kasir 2 shift closes are verified by Admin. Admin shift close is verified by Pimpinan.
recommendation.audit: Every close, verification, variance resolution and authorized reopening is recorded in audit.

ownerMustConfirm: Who may resolve a shift variance and authorize reopening, if different from the verifier

recommendation.approval: No refund obligation may be approved without an explicit Pimpinan decision. Admin may perform the existing first-stage review, but cannot replace Pimpinan approval.
recommendation.obligation: Pimpinan approval creates a refund obligation; it does not by itself record that money has been paid.
recommendation.payout: Record refund status and amount only. When the refund has been transferred, Pimpinan-facing report states that it has been transferred and the amount (for example, 'sudah ditransfer Rp X ke rekening'). Do not require or store refund method, bank account number/name, destination account details, or transfer reference as mandatory fields. Keep approval status separate from transferred/paid status; never mark paid merely because Pimpinan approved it.
recommendation.partialPayout: Not enabled until a partial payout policy is explicitly approved.

blocks: Only block status transition to transferred/paid until an authorized user records that transfer occurred and its amount; no bank-account catalogue or payment-method setup is required
evidence: Audit record of transferred status and amount

recommendation.initialState: Non-cash payment is recorded in pending_pimpinan_review and is not yet included in recognized income.
recommendation.recognition: After Pimpinan reviews and approves the payment, the amount is posted to recognized income.
recommendation.settlement: Income recognition and bank/provider settlement remain separate. Until settlement evidence exists, the amount remains in a pending/clearing balance, not available bank cash.
recommendation.rejection: Pimpinan rejection leaves the item out of recognized income and records the reason.
recommendation.reversal: A subsequent failed/reversed settlement creates an attributable reversal/adjustment; never erase the original review/payment event.
recommendation.fees: Provider fees are recorded separately so gross recognized income and net settlement can be reconciled.

ownerMustConfirm: Supported non-cash channels and source evidence for later settlement matching
blocks: Non-cash income recognition endpoint until Pimpinan review is implemented

recommendation.openingCount: Perform stock opname on the first day of each month; Admin counts physical stock by medicine and batch and Pimpinan reviews/approves the result.
recommendation.valuation: Use documented supplier purchase cost or another explicitly approved valuation source; never infer HPP from selling price.
recommendation.knownBatchUnknownHpp: If batch and expiry are clear but HPP is unknown, keep quantity recorded and saleable; visibly mark HPP unknown and exclude that item's profit from valid profit calculation until verified.
recommendation.unknownLineage: If batch origin or expiry cannot be established, quarantine the quantity; it is not sellable until verified.
recommendation.expiredOrDamaged: Expired or damaged stock remains quarantined pending Pimpinan disposition.
recommendation.legacyDataset: Existing Firebase operational dataset is dummy/testing data; do not promote it to genuine opening balances. Establish production opening stock through approved physical count.

ownerMustConfirm: Initial stock opname/cutover date and approved treatment of each quarantined item
blocks: Opening-balance posting and live stock cutover

recommendation.laneRule: Morning shift uses lane A assigned to Kasir 1 (assalamkasir1@gmail.com); evening shift uses lane B assigned to Kasir 2 (assalamkasir2@gmail.com).
recommendation.transfer: A cashier may transfer a patient/ticket to another cashier/shift only with a recorded reason and an auditable handover event.
recommendation.admin: Admin may assist with queue transfers/moves; the acting Admin and reason are recorded.
recommendation.pimpinan: Pimpinan has full authority to manage, transfer, override and correct queue assignments, with audit.
recommendation.audit: Every queue transaction and movement, including registration, call, recall, cancellation, transfer and override, is recorded with actor, timestamp, before/after state and reason where applicable.
recommendation.activeCall: One active call per lane/shift; A and B may each have one active call at the same time.
recommendation.display: Changing the TV view does not reset counters, active calls or ticket history.

evidence: Owner confirmation of separate lanes per shift

recommendation.preserveRaw: Retain exact raw source value and field.
recommendation.normalize: Convert to UTC only with explicit zone/offset or source-declared epoch unit.
recommendation.ambiguous: Missing, malformed, date-only or ambiguous local times remain unnormalized and are marked needs_review; never replace with migration time.
recommendation.reporting: Keep unresolved timestamps out of date-sensitive reporting until reviewed.

blocks: Date-sensitive historical reporting for affected ambiguous records
evidence: Source collection/field profile still required to declare epoch units

decisions.area: Application scope and retention for administrative patient/financial data (not clinical record content)

recommendation.applicationScope: This is an administrative and financial application for patient identity/basic visit administration, billing, payments, stock and clinic finances. It is not the clinical medical-record application.
recommendation.accountingDocuments: Books, records and documents forming the basis of bookkeeping/accounting and electronic processing outputs are retained for at least 10 years where PP 50/2022 Article 11 applies to the clinic/taxpayer.
recommendation.personalData: Patient identity/contact data follows the Personal Data Protection Law: stop processing when the retention period or purpose ends, and erase/destroy when statutory conditions apply, subject to other legal retention duties and legal hold.
recommendation.noBlanketRule: Do not impose the electronic medical-record 25-year rule on every administrative/financial field in this application. Classify retention by data purpose and legal basis.
recommendation.separateClinicObligation: This application does not replace any separate Electronic Medical Record system/process required of a clinic under Permenkes 24/2022 Article 3.

ownerMustConfirm: Classify each patient/admin field and financial record against its actual purpose and statutory retention basis
Confirm separate clinical medical-record system/process is maintained outside this application
blocks: Automatic deletion/purge until a field-level retention schedule and legal hold process are approved

decisions.area: Audit retention, export and legal hold

recommendation.auditLog: Server-authored append-only audit; operational roles cannot edit/delete authoritative events.
recommendation.retention: Retain audit events for at least 1 year. If another applicable law, accounting/tax requirement, dispute, investigation or legal hold requires longer retention, retain for the longer required period. Do not automatically delete events under an active legal hold.
recommendation.export: Include range, actor, event type, target, request/correlation ID and integrity checksum; exporting itself creates an audit event.
recommendation.legalHold: Suspend purge for affected records while an investigation, dispute, audit or legal hold applies.
recommendation.purge: No automatic purge until the schedule and authority for each category have been approved.

blocks: Configure category-specific retention and longer legal/accounting holds; one year is a minimum, not permission to delete records subject to longer duties

recommendation.provider: Use Better Auth with TiDB as the application authentication/session store; the new system does not depend on Firebase Authentication for user login.
recommendation.authority: Backend validates sessions and resolves role/active state from server-owned records; never accept role, actor or user ID asserted by browser payload.
recommendation.pimpinanUserManagement: Pimpinan can register/create users, assign approved roles, update user identity, disable/reactivate accounts and initiate secure password reset/invitation workflows. No public self-registration.
recommendation.protectedAccounts: Preserve all five protected email identities and linked historical records. Do not silently merge identities or infer the role of nursalim422@gmail.com.
recommendation.credentials: Do not migrate or store Firebase passwords. Existing users activate/set a new password through a secure invitation or reset flow.
recommendation.recovery: Account recovery, email change, disable/reactivate and privileged role changes are explicit audited workflows. Pimpinan authority and emergency recovery path must be protected against lockout.
recommendation.sessionSecurity: Use secure server-managed sessions, HTTPS, secure HttpOnly cookies, rate limiting and session revocation.

ownerMustConfirm: Verify authoritative identity/profile/role mapping for the five protected accounts, especially nursalim422@gmail.com
Confirm emergency recovery procedure if the primary Pimpinan account is inaccessible
blocks: Account seeding until protected identity mapping is verified
Production auth cutover until recovery and session-revocation tests pass
